name: bandit.r009_m095_current_route_safe_watch_mcw
description: R-009 M095 uses fixed input only to reset and stage the ordinary route, save/relaunch, and native camp. The semantic trace gate survives that process boundary and excludes unrelated debug traffic; one worker then owns natural time through frame-bound observe-act choices whose accepted actions require native receipts and a fresh next state before the structural scout audit.

proof_gates.label: Exact structural scout persisted after adaptive natural time

steps.label: post_load_hud
steps.abort_reason: the source save did not reach ordinary gameplay

steps.label: preview_ordinary_travel_to_163_36
steps.expected_visible_fact: CHOOSE_DESTINATION previews the route to the selected destination; it does not itself begin travel

steps.label: confirm_ordinary_travel_to_163_36
steps.expected_visible_fact: the same CHOOSE_DESTINATION binding advances the previewed route to native confirmation

steps.label: accept_ordinary_travel_confirmation
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native confirmation accepts ordinary travel to (163,36,0)

steps.label: audit_ordinary_travel_confirmation
steps.abort_reason: the native Y confirmation did not commit the nonempty ordinary route to (163,36,0)

steps.label: post_travel_hud
steps.abort_reason: the current executable did not return to the gameplay HUD after the ordinary route

steps.label: audit_player_save_before_route_arrival_save
steps.abort_reason: the copied production-created save was absent before preserving the confirmed ordinary arrival

steps.label: open_native_full_save_after_route_arrival
steps.abort_reason: the normal Save-and-Quit confirmation was not visibly open after confirmed ordinary travel

steps.label: audit_player_save_after_route_arrival_save
steps.abort_reason: the native Save-and-Quit action did not preserve the confirmed ordinary arrival

steps.label: open_native_main_menu_quit_confirmation
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native main-menu quit confirmation owns an active semantic modal instance after saving the ordinary arrival
steps.abort_reason: Save-and-Quit did not expose the authoritative main-menu quit confirmation modal and its advertised input

steps.label: confirm_native_process_exit_after_route_arrival
steps.expected_visible_fact: the original route-arrival process exits before the saved player reloads

steps.label: post_route_arrival_reload_hud
steps.abort_reason: the native route-arrival save did not reload into gameplay before native camp UI

steps.label: post_travel_player_omt
steps.abort_reason: ordinary travel did not persist the player at the selected route-proven OMT (163,36,0) before native camp UI

steps.label: confirm_native_basecamp_name
steps.abort_reason: the follower dialogue did not create a native player basecamp and return to gameplay

steps.label: wait_first_6_hours_toward_force_due
steps.objective: Own the complete M095/R-008 natural playtest. Observe the current frame, choose only advertised semantic actions, treat interruptions or divergences as the next observation, and continue toward a persisted structural scout and lifecycle evidence.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the same worker observes the wait mode, selects Wait a while and six hours semantically, receives native receipts, and observes real game-time advance

steps.label: wait_second_6_hours_through_force_due
steps.objective: Continue the same M095/R-008 worker session from the resulting world frame through force due; adapt to every advertised interruption without replacement.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the same worker continues from the first resulting frame toward the structural scout outcome

steps.label: wait_third_6_hours_through_scheduler_cooldown
steps.objective: Continue the same M095/R-008 worker session. The first scheduler pass set a persisted dispatch cooldown ending at game minute 9360, so observe and choose only advertised semantic actions until the next eligible natural scheduler pass.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the same worker advances natural game time from the second semantic wait without synthesizing ecology state

steps.label: wait_fourth_6_hours_through_scheduler_cooldown
steps.objective: Continue the same M095/R-008 worker session from the resulting world frame. Keep the native semantic loop through the persisted scheduler cooldown; any interruption remains the next observation.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the same worker keeps ownership of the ordinary wait sequence through the next native six-hour interval

steps.label: wait_fifth_6_hours_to_first_eligible_dispatch
steps.objective: Continue the same M095/R-008 worker session until the persisted scheduler cooldown becomes eligible. Observe the current frame and use only its advertised semantic actions; do not create a lead, pair, route, or operation.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native scheduler receives its first eligible post-cooldown interval while ecology state remains production-owned

steps.label: audit_first_structural_scout_consumer
steps.abort_reason: the force-due scheduler did not persist one exact structural scout consumer for the native route-proven opportunity

steps.label: audit_same_run_structural_scout_dispatch
steps.abort_reason: the same run lacks a producer-to-consumer dispatch artifact for the exact native opportunity

evidence_contract.claim: the current executable revalidates a nonempty ordinary route to (163,36,0); a native player basecamp there persists across save/reload and naturally produces one exact structural scout consumer through the production safe-watch selector
evidence_contract.failure_rule: A divergence is the next run-bound observation and diagnostic evidence. Keep the same worker session in the semantic loop unless authority, material risk, external state, or the whole-task deadline prevents continuation. Never inject or synthesize ecology lifecycle state.
